thread:
alex: Heads-up — vuln triage last night pulled a larger set of SIEM events than expected. We need to tighten retention windows for triage exports and clarify who can request full raw exports.
maria: Ugh, saw that. Which export pipeline did it hit? Was it streaming or a snapshot?
alex: Snapshot export from forensic-snapshot-service. Command in runbook was accidentally set to full-24h instead of 2h.
sam: Can we gate snapshot exports behind a JIT approval flow? Preferably short TTL tokens so analysts can't pull long windows.
jen: Agreed. Also need to ensure KMS unwrap is scoped — only oncall or a delegated analyst role should be able to unwrap CMK for a snapshot.
security-bot: Note: last night export id export-20260322-91 contained PII fields flagged by DLP. Ticket created: ENGSEC-432.
oncall: @alex @maria tagging oncall to confirm we revoked the snapshot URL. I rotated the pre-signed link at 09:12 UTC.
alex: Thanks. Next steps I propose: 1) update runbook default snapshot window to 2h; 2) add RBAC check in exporter service; 3) require ephemeral KMS unwrap with approval; 4) add post-export scrub job. Thoughts?
maria: +1. For RBAC check: can we require a short-lived scope claim like export:forensics:ttl=2h and enforcement via OPA?
sam: Yup, OPA policy sounds right. Example OPA snippet: 
```
package exporter.auth
allow {
 input.requester in data.roles["forensics_analyst"]
 input.params.ttl <= 7200
}
```
jen: Also add a human-approval step for >30m exports. Small exports auto-approve via service-account, larger need ticket ID in request (ENGSEC-432 style).
alex: Good catch — threshold 30m makes sense. For KMS: we should require CMK unwrap audit log to include requestor, ticket id, and ephemeral token id. Can we add that to key policy?
maria: We can add an IAM condition requiring the request context to have audit:ticket_id. If missing, deny. Will need a ticket to update key policy and get compliance signoff.
jen: I'll draft the KMS policy change and put it in a PR. Who owns the oncall flow? @oncall?
oncall: I can own temporary gating and rotation. I'll open TICKET-ENG-754 to track. Will also add a playbook step to revoke pre-signed URLs after 10m.
sam: Also add streaming exports to the audit — streaming currently allowed for 24h windows; make that 1h for triage streams and require no PII fields unless scrubbed.
alex: Action items: jen PR for key policy, maria OPA policy PR, oncall ticket for URL rotation, sam update exporter service config, alex will coordinate compliance review. I'll schedule a quick sync 10:30 UTC to unblock.
maria: One more: can we add an automated check that flags any export request where DLP risk score > 0.6 and auto-pause? Saves manual work.
jen: Yep, DLP hook is doable. I'll add a webhook to webhook://dlp-check that exporter runs before generating snapshot.
oncall: Confirmed revoke and short TTL applied to last night's bad export. All good for now.
alex: Thanks team. I'll capture notes in ENGSEC-432 and link PRs. :thumbsup:
